instructions_to_main_agent: Use Framer Motion for scroll-triggered animations and hover effects (e.g., subtle parallax, fade-ups).
Ensure all buttons and cards use the specified border-radius (18-24px) for consistency unless fully rounded.
Form implementation: use react-hook-form + zod with Shadcn UI Form components.
Admin dashboard must be functional with a dummy state for the leads table, featuring Shadcn Table, Dropdowns for status updates, and a Drawer for lead details.
Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide Icons with light stroke weights to match the elegant vibe.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use complete transparent background in header if it overlaps unreadable content; use backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FAF8F5]/80.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Avoid generic 'centered everything'. Use asymmetry and grid alignments for a more editorial look.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Do not add universal transitions (e.g. `transition: all`) which breaks transform animations.
Never use `App { text-align: center; }` in CSS.
Mocked flows: Admin authentication (hardcode a simple login state), CSV export (can just download a hardcoded blob).
